close_reason: Resolved per the finding's alternative path: docstring decision record locks in Option<UTCDate> as correct. Three failure modes are all 'corrupted clock' — physically unreachable on a sane host, one operational bucket, three physical mechanisms. Workspace's typed-variant-per-mode shape (SetError, BackendChangesError, MergePatchError) is for modes that DO occur in normal operation; clock corruption is different in kind. Zero current callers of now_utc_string_checked outside the helper itself, so the migration cost is hypothetical. Future per-mode telemetry can be added non-breakingly as a parallel helper. Commit b160214.
title: now_utc_string_checked Option<UTCDate> erases failure-mode discriminator — Result<UTCDate, ClockError> preserves observability
